name: event_id
description: Deterministic UUIDv5 over (tenant_id, actor, action, dedup_key); doubles as streaming insertId for replay dedup

name: tenant_id
description: Owning tenant; always sourced from verified JWT claims, never client input

name: actor
description: agent_name (e.g. ingestion-agent) or reviewer_id for human actions

name: action
description: Machine-readable action, e.g. document.ingested, check.escalated, check.approved

name: before_state
description: Entity state before the action (null for creations)

name: after_state
description: Entity state after the action (null for deletions/failures)
